answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with quadratic staking: each identity locks slashable collateral, but voting weight equals the square root of its stake. Splitting one budget across many fake agents cannot amplify power—sqrt shares sum to less than a single consolidated bond—while every extra identity still pays registration and upkeep fees. Honest agents trade a reputation whisper, attest nectar rewards, and slash double-signers; like water carving karst, penalties compound. The attacker funds every mask yet buys less influence than one honest agent.
